title: 分页插件改写 SQL：给定原 SQL 与页码，输出分页语句与 count 语句（含 GROUP BY/UNION 反例）
expected_output:
orig            : SELECT * FROM t_user WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY id DESC
page 2/size 10  : SELECT * FROM t_user WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 10,10
count (plain)   : SELECT count(0) FROM t_user WHERE status = 1
groupby count   : SELECT count(0) FROM (SELECT dept_id, count(0) c FROM t_user GROUP BY dept_id) tmp
union page      : SELECT * FROM (SELECT id FROM a UNION SELECT id FROM b) tmp LIMIT 0,5
union count     : SELECT count(0) FROM (SELECT id FROM a UNION SELECT id FROM b) tmp
count plain 1row: true
naive count sql : SELECT count(0) FROM t_user GROUP BY dept_id
naive count 1row: false
naive wrong     : true
